legal.privacyContent:
Privacy Policy

Last updated: April 25, 2026

1. Data Controller

DishRank SAS is responsible for processing your personal data.

DPO contact: contact@dishrank.fr

2. Data Collected

  • Sign-up: email, username, display name, password (encrypted), profile picture.
  • Content: reviews, ratings, dish photos, restaurant names, comments, reactions.
  • Social data: friendship graph, friend requests, group memberships, private messages exchanged in groups, message reactions, polls, votes and RSVPs for outings, history of restaurants chosen by the group.
  • Location: geolocation (only with your explicit consent), used to show nearby dishes and compute a group centroid.
  • Technical: device type, OS, unique identifier, push token, app version, language.
  • Usage: in-app interactions and preferences (only if you enabled usage statistics).

3. Purposes

  • Account creation and management
  • Publishing and displaying your reviews and photos
  • Providing the social features: friends, groups, chat, polls, outings
  • Recommending restaurants near a group's centroid
  • Sending notifications (likes, comments, friend requests, messages, outings, popular dishes)
  • Content moderation and enforcement of the community guidelines
  • Service improvement and anonymized statistical analysis

4. Legal bases

  • Performance of contract: account, reviews, friendships, groups, chat, outings
  • Consent: location, push, marketing, usage statistics
  • Legitimate interest: security, abuse prevention, moderation, reports
  • Legal obligation: log retention required by law

5. Retention period

  • Account and profile: deleted within 30 days of the request
  • Reviews, photos, reactions, group messages, polls: kept while published, deleted with the account
  • Friendships: deleted with the account of either party
  • Groups: auto-deleted when only one member remains; history preserved for remaining members
  • Resolved reports: 12 months
  • Location data: not stored permanently, used in real time
  • Push tokens: cleared on logout or account deletion
  • Technical logs: 12 months maximum

6. Data sharing

Your data is hosted and processed by:

  • Supabase (hosting, auth, photo storage) — servers in Europe
  • Expo Application Services (build, push relay)
  • Apple Push Notification Service and Firebase Cloud Messaging — only push token and message payload
  • OpenStreetMap Overpass (nearby restaurant search) — only approximate coordinates
  • Google Maps (opening directions) — only on your explicit request

We never sell your data. No data is shared with other users without your explicit action.

7. International transfers

Data is primarily stored in Europe. Some sub-processors (Apple, Google for push) may process data in the US under standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.

8. Your rights (GDPR)

  • Access, rectification, erasure, portability (JSON export including reviews, friendships, group memberships, sent messages)
  • Objection, restriction, withdrawal of consent
  • Block a user from their profile
  • Report content from any review, comment, message or profile

Exercisable from Settings → Personal data, or by email to contact@dishrank.fr.

9. Security

  • Password hashing (bcrypt)
  • HTTPS/TLS encryption in transit
  • At-rest encryption on Supabase (AES-256)
  • Row Level Security: access limited to your own data or content explicitly shared
  • JWT tokens with automatic renewal

10. Minors

The app is intended for users aged 16 and over.

11. Complaint

CNIL — 3 Place de Fontenoy, TSA 80715, 75334 Paris Cedex 07 — www.cnil.fr

12. Contact

contact@dishrank.fr — DishRank SAS, Paris
legal.termsContent:
Terms of Service

Last updated: April 25, 2026

1. Acceptance

By using DishRank, you accept these Terms of Service and the community guidelines.

2. Service description

DishRank lets you rate and share reviews on dishes, add friends, create private groups, organize outings and chat with short messages in those groups.

3. Sign-up

You must be at least 16 years old. You are responsible for your credentials and account usage.

4. User content

  • You are the original author of any content you publish (reviews, photos, messages, polls)
  • You grant DishRank a non-exclusive license to display your content
  • You can remove your content at any time

5. Conduct rules

  • No fake reviews, no artificial like swaps, no multiple accounts
  • No harassment, hate speech, doxing or illegal content
  • Photos = dishes you have actually tasted yourself
  • Groups must not be used for commercial spam

6. Moderation

Any content can be reported via the in-app tools. Progressive sanctions: warning → 30 days → 1 year → permanent ban. Severe violations result in an immediate ban.

7. Applicable law

French law. Paris courts have jurisdiction.

8. Contact

contact@dishrank.fr
legal.deleteContent:
Account deletion

1. From the app

Profile → Settings → Personal data → Delete my account

2. By email

Send to contact@dishrank.fr with subject "Account deletion".

Data removed

  • Profile, reviews, photos, comments, likes, bookmarks
  • Friendships and pending friend requests
  • Group memberships and messages you sent (other members keep the group history)
  • Polls, votes and RSVPs you created
  • Settings, notifications, push tokens

30 days grace period before permanent deletion (cancellable from the app during this period).
